actions: Refactored useCanvasHistory.ts to delegate pure undo/redo logic to historyReducer.ts (createEmptyHistory, commitHistory, undoHistory, redoHistory). Hook now only handles React concerns (refs, setTimeout debounce, useState flags).

Replaced lucide-react imports in CanvasZoomControls.tsx with @ant-design/icons equivalents: CompassOutlined, AimOutlined, QuestionCircleOutlined.

selfReflection: Loop 2 completed the canvas core capability. The main challenge was antd's TypeScript types: useToken().theme is typed as Theme<SeedToken, AliasToken> which does not expose algorithm (it exists at runtime but not in types). Solved by detecting dark mode from token.colorBgBase luminance — type-safe and robust. Also replaced lucide-react (not installed) with @ant-design/icons. All 22 canvas tests pass, tsc clean. The core is ready for persistence and panel integration.

selfAssessment.reason: Canvas core is fully implemented and verified with 22 passing tests. No blockers for persistence or panel integration. Architecture (generic CanvasNode<T>, controlled component, pure historyReducer) is sound.
